case.assigned_absent_dependency: Do not use H or its parts; retained function unchanged. Only pins exist and tap requires H: source-supported no-opening.
case.evidence_kind: stipulated finite model, not measured physics

facts.text: Two initially aligned panels must retain at least 4 units at ticks 3–6, then separate with all installed retainers removed by boundary 10. No damage/discard/substitution/outside resource.
One operator; one action per integer tick, completes next boundary. Resources cannot occupy two places simultaneously. H initially intact; all other parts free.
detach(H) frees M and S; assemble(H) requires both free. Neither creates retention. H requires M and S to remain assembled for tap.
tap(P1/P2) requires intact H and free pin; each installed pin supplies 2 units. pull removes installed pin. Only pins add capacities; no pins with non-pin retainer.
install(C) supplies 4 retention; remove(C) removes clip.
install(V) then insert(S,V) with detached/free S supplies min(4,4) retention; withdraw(S,V) then remove(V) releases.
place(M) after detach(H), then route(L), supplies min(4,4) retention. unroute(L) then lift(M) releases. Both are needed.
install(Q) supplies theta in {0,4}; theta is initially unmeasured. measure(Q) returns exact theta in one tick, never itself creates retention. remove(Q) releases. No assumed theta.
At most one non-pin retaining assembly installed; it cannot combine with pins. No unlisted operation, adhesive, welding, elastic extrapolation or sustained manual support.
The conventional archive contains two-pin fastening and clip fastening. All supported properties are common to all arms; these known constructions are not locally original.
The discrete-fastener grammar and impact budget b=2 are soft benchmark conventions/preferences, not mechanical laws. b may be set to 2,1,0 only in declared ladder cells.
Available identities: ['H', 'P1', 'P2']. Capacity values above are complete; unknowns are not free variables.

case.grammar: Discrete fastening is a mutable benchmark convention; hard requirements are unchanged.

job.instructions: Retrieve only the supplied retained card, then construct on the unfamiliar/current case; flag procedural non-applicability rather than invent properties.

method.instructions: Analyze the supplied situation by routine fit, feasibility and an existing useful next action. Consolidate the most plausible account early, retain honest unknowns and propose one ordinary operation or explicit no-opening.

retrieved_card.applicability: Applicable when an ordinary construction can be assessed from explicit requirements, resource availability, operation prerequisites and supported causal effects. Re-extract these from each new task; prior feasibility does not transfer automatically.
retrieved_card.burden: Account for installation, reversal and restoration work as well as active operation. Resource occupation and loss of tool availability count as displaced work. More assembly steps do not establish greater supported contribution; fewer actions are useful only when the full invariant still holds.
retrieved_card.conditions: Use only supplied available resources, supported properties and legal operations. Separate hard requirements from soft preferences. Consolidate the most plausible ordinary account early while keeping honest unknowns visible.
retrieved_card.counterexample: A construction can finish assembly and later release correctly yet fail because its supported contribution remains below the required function during the holding phase. Adding procedural work cannot remove that ceiling. A deliberate negative exercise illustrates this refusal condition and does not estimate an organic failure rate.
retrieved_card.evidence_boundary: This procedure was consolidated from supplied practice outputs and their stipulated-model replays. Those replays support model consequences, without demonstrating physical performance, originality or comparative method superiority.
retrieved_card.invariant: Keep the required function intact through every required phase, including final release or reversal. Preserve hard resource, legality and non-damage constraints while considering alternatives.
mapping_construction_obligation: Map the current requirements onto an available ordinary mechanism whose supported contribution meets the whole function.
Construct the complete legal operation sequence, checking serial execution, prerequisite completion, resource occupancy, sustained function, removal and required restoration.
Recalculate composition under the supplied rule; do not assume contributions add when only a bottleneck or exclusive assembly is allowed.
Compare supported ordinary alternatives by the same invariant and their operator actions, impacts, occupied resources and displaced work.
Select one existing useful next operation for the consolidated account, or state no supported opening. Keep predictions distinct from received replay feedback.
retrieved_card.method: Routine fit, feasibility and an existing useful next action.
retrieved_card.operation: Start with routine fit rather than inventing a mechanism. Use received feedback to check whether a failure came from insufficient supported contribution, an illegal transition, a missed required phase or excessive burden. Preserve an ordinary construction when it fits; an available ordinary alternative may reduce burden without changing the required function.
property_extraction: Extract the demanded function, required phases, completion rules, availability, exclusivity and release obligations.
Extract each ordinary mechanism’s prerequisites, supported contribution, combination rule, ceiling and inverse operations.
Mark unmeasured properties and unavailable resources explicitly; neither is a free variable.
Record which constructions are already conventional and which preferences are mutable only under explicit permission.
retrieved_card.refusal: Refuse a construction requiring unavailable parts, unsupported property changes, forbidden combinations, invented operations, assumed unknown outcomes or relaxed hard requirements. If no supported ordinary sequence fits, report no opening and identify the specific missing support.
retrieved_card.retention: Store and retrieve this external procedure card as explicit file state. Re-extract task properties on application; external retrieval does not modify model weights.
retrieved_card.uncertainty: Carry unmeasured properties as unknown. Use measurement only when the resource and operation are available and the resulting decision can still satisfy the task. Do not treat measuring as performing the required function.
